responsibility: Defines rustc_middle’s dependency-node universe by generating the `DepKind` set, the exported dep-kind constants and label mappings, and the typed APIs for constructing and recovering `DepNode` values. It owns how compiler entities such as `DefId`, `HirId`, crate identifiers, and mono/codegen items are converted to stable fingerprints and debug strings so dependency graph nodes remain valid and comparable across compilation sessions.
